description: This file defines the UnixSocketConnectionListenerFactory class, which implements IConnectionListenerFactory to create and bind Unix domain socket connection listeners within the Orleans testing host environment.

classes.name: UnixSocketConnectionListenerFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and binding Unix domain socket connection listeners for Orleans testing host.

methods.name: UnixSocketConnectionListenerFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with logger, socket options, and schedulers.

methods.name: BindAsync
methods.description: Creates and binds a Unix socket connection listener to the specified endpoint asynchronously.
